title: Cardinality bound for the Goldreich–Levin output
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be any target function, let $0<\tau\le1$ be a rational threshold, and let an estimate assign a rational number to each pair consisting of a coordinate subset $J$ and a subset $S\subseteq J$. Suppose each estimate differs from the corresponding restricted Fourier weight of $f$ by less than $\tau^2/4$. If the Goldreich–Levin output for this estimate is a family $A$, then its cardinality satisfies $|A|\le4/\tau^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a target function from the sign cube to the signs
the estimate differs from every corresponding restricted Fourier weight by less than $\tau^2/4$
the Goldreich–Levin output equals the family $A$
